name: HIST
tagline: LSTM/GRU encoder followed by predefined-concept aggregation, hidden-concept mining, and an individual-information branch summed at the readout.
diff_from_baseline: Xu et al. 2021 (HIST, IJCAI). Mines shared concept information across stocks via predefined membership and hidden-concept cosine similarity, then combines with an individual residual stream. Verbatim re-impl of qlib pytorch_hist.py with Alpha360 hyperparameters.

name: GATs (Graph Attention)
tagline: LSTM/GRU encoder per stock, then a fully-connected daily attention layer where each stock attends to all others before the prediction head.
diff_from_baseline: Velickovic et al. 2018 (GAT, ICLR) adapted by qlib's pytorch_gats.py. RNN sequence encoder followed by a learned daily all-pairs attention; prediction = (att·H + H) -> Linear -> 1.

name: LightGBM (Alpha360)
tagline: Gradient-boosted decision trees on Alpha360 features with the qlib official LightGBM hyperparameters; non-graph reference baseline.
diff_from_baseline: Ke et al. 2017 (LightGBM, NeurIPS). Histogram-based GBDT used as the default qlib baseline; treats each (stock, day) row independently and ignores the stock-concept graph structure.
